step.name: initialise-workspace
step.action: pnpm-workspace.yaml lists packages. Each package has its own package.json with `name` matching directory.

step.name: hoist-shared-configs
step.action: Hoist `tsconfig.base.json` and the eslint preset to the root; rewrite each package config to extend them. Replace every cross-package relative import with the workspace name and add the lint rule that keeps them out.
step.decision-gate: If a package cannot compile under the base's strict flags, fix the package — do not relax the base and do not opt the package out.

step.name: author-turbo-json
step.action: Declare tasks (build, test, lint, dev) with dependsOn edges, plus `inputs` and `outputs` per task. Use `^build` for upstream package dependencies.

step.name: pin-versions
step.action: Replace `^X.Y.Z` with `X.Y.Z`. Add `packageManager: pnpm@X.Y.Z` to root package.json.
step.decision-gate: If any dep cannot be pinned (transitive constraint), document and pin to a narrow range.

step.name: declare-cache-inputs-and-outputs
step.action: For each task declare `outputs` (dist/, .next/, coverage/) and `inputs` (src/**, tsconfig.json, package.json). Run `turbo run build` twice — the second run should be 100% cache hits — then touch a README and confirm the build still hits cache, which is what proves `inputs` is right.

step.name: wire-remote-cache-in-ci
step.action: Add env vars to CI. Verify CI cache hits show in turbo summary. Confirm across PRs.

step.name: scope-ci-matrix
step.action: Convert the single CI job into a matrix scoped by `turbo --filter` to the packages the change touches. Confirm an unrelated package no longer appears in the run.
